articles.summary: Recently, we integrated Redis through AWS ElastiCache to power real-time updates in our AI-driven menu recommendation system. Our initial cloud setup was straightforward: a Rails 8 application deployed with Kamal on a t3a.small EC2 instance ($27.07/month) and RDS for the database ($32.47/month), totaling around $70/month across environments.
articles.title: Dropping Redis for Rails Slashed Our AWS Bill by 62%
